title: Passkeys Server Initialization & Challenge Generation
instruction: Verify that Hono boots with FIDO2 / WebAuthn Level 3 compliance and generates valid cryptographic challenges.
assertions: GET /health returns HTTP 200 with passkeys_active: true
GET /api/auth/register-options returns base64url challenge and rp parameters
GET /api/auth/authenticate-options generates challenge with residentKey support
Challenge length is at least 32 bytes
